description: Who can use which account: mailboxes, calendars, meeting accounts, file accounts, local bridges, runners and agents (resource_type 'agent': who may see and use that agent). Each account has an owner (full access; for an agent the person who created it) and optional assignments to persons (access) or roles (role_access) with read / write / manage. Admins see every account in the tenant but do NOT read contents unless assigned; others see the accounts they own or manage. Filter with resource_type and/or user_id (accounts that person owns or is assigned to). Read-only.
name: list_account_access
